eachRound.name: Each Round
eachRound.desc: Fires at the start of the first round in which the conditions hold.

bloodied.name: Bloodied
bloodied.desc: Fires when a blow takes this character under half health.

mpDry.name: Running Dry
mpDry.desc: Fires when a skill spends this character's last MP.

fallenAlly.name: Fallen Ally
fallenAlly.desc: Fires when any ally falls in battle.

memberFalls.name: Member Falls
memberFalls.desc: Fires when the chosen party member is knocked out.

takedown.name: Takedown
takedown.desc: Fires when this character defeats an enemy.

hitByElement.name: Struck by Element
hitByElement.desc: Fires when this character is hit by the chosen element.

dealtElement.name: Strike with Element
dealtElement.desc: Fires when this character lands a blow of the chosen element.

stateOnEnemy.name: Enemy State
stateOnEnemy.desc: Fires when the chosen state takes hold of an enemy.

struckTrue.name: Struck True
struckTrue.desc: Fires when this character takes a critical hit.

deathsDoor.name: Death's Door
deathsDoor.desc: Fires on the blow that would knock this character out: they hold on at 1 HP instead.

stateOnSelf.name: State Taken
stateOnSelf.desc: Fires when the chosen state takes hold of this character.

afflicted.name: Afflicted
afflicted.desc: Fires when any harmful state takes hold of this character.

levelUp.name: Growth
levelUp.desc: Fires when this character gains a level.

spend.name: Big Spender
spend.desc: Fires when the party spends at least the chosen sum at once.

mapHurt.name: Hurt on the Road
mapHurt.desc: Fires when this character is hurt outside a battle.

weatherTurns.name: Weather Turns
weatherTurns.desc: Fires when the weather turns to the chosen one.

heatRises.name: Heat Rises
heatRises.desc: Fires when the police's attention on the party grows.

crime.name: Crime
crime.desc: Fires when the party is charged with a crime.

needLow.name: Running Low
needLow.desc: Fires when the chosen need falls under a quarter.

diseased.name: Infection
diseased.desc: Fires when this character catches a disease.

allergic.name: Allergy
allergic.desc: Fires when this character has an allergic reaction.

empathize.name: Conversation
empathize.desc: Fires when the chosen Empathize action is taken with somebody.

admired.name: Admired
admired.desc: Fires when somebody's opinion of this character rises.

scorned.name: Scorned
scorned.desc: Fires when somebody's opinion of this character falls.

rested.name: Rested
rested.desc: Fires when the party wakes from sleep.

questDone.name: Quest Done
questDone.desc: Fires when a quest is completed.

arrive.name: Arrival
arrive.desc: Fires when the party arrives somewhere new.

outnumbered.name: Outnumbered
outnumbered.desc: Holds while the enemies standing outnumber the party.

wounded.name: Wounded
wounded.desc: Holds while this character is under half health.

night.name: Night
night.desc: Holds between eight in the evening and six in the morning.

brimming.name: Brimming
brimming.desc: Holds while this character has at least three quarters of their MP.

weatherIs.name: Weather
weatherIs.desc: Holds while the weather is the chosen one.

indoors.name: Indoors
indoors.desc: Holds while the party is under a roof.

earlyRounds.name: Early Rounds
earlyRounds.desc: Holds during the first three rounds of a battle.

wealthy.name: Wealthy
wealthy.desc: Holds while the party carries at least the chosen sum.

wanted.name: Wanted
wanted.desc: Holds while the police are after the party.

needLowNow.name: In Need
needLowNow.desc: Holds while the chosen need is under a quarter.

memberStanding.name: Member Standing
memberStanding.desc: Holds while the chosen party member is on their feet.

memberDown.name: Member Down
memberDown.desc: Holds while the chosen party member is knocked out.

alone.name: Alone
alone.desc: Holds while nobody else in the party is standing.

sick.name: Sick
sick.desc: Holds while this character carries a disease.

selfHasState.name: Under a State
selfHasState.desc: Holds while this character has the chosen state.

enemyHasState.name: Enemy Under a State
enemyHasState.desc: Holds while an enemy has the chosen state.

bossFight.name: Boss Fight
bossFight.desc: Holds while a boss stands among the enemies.

duel.name: Duel
duel.desc: Holds while a single enemy is left standing.

lastStand.name: Last Stand
lastStand.desc: Holds while this character is at a quarter of their health or less. Counts as four vows.

mend.name: Mend
mend.desc: Restores part of this character's health.

focus.name: Focus
focus.desc: Restores part of this character's MP.

restoreNeed.name: Replenish
restoreNeed.desc: Restores a good part of the chosen need.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Raises this character's CON and WIS for three turns.

fury.name: Fury
fury.desc: Raises this character's STR for three turns.

quicken.name: Quicken
quicken.desc: Raises this character's DEX for three turns.

purge.name: Purge
purge.desc: Clears every harmful state from this character.

mendMember.name: Mend Member
mendMember.desc: Restores part of the chosen party member's health.

windfall.name: Windfall
windfall.desc: A little money turns up in the party's pockets.

grant.name: Grant
grant.desc: Gives this character the chosen state.

inflict.name: Inflict
inflict.desc: Tries to put the chosen state on every enemy.

coolHeat.name: Lie Low
coolHeat.desc: The police lose some interest in the party.

cure.name: Cure
cure.desc: Cures this character's diseases and allergic reactions.

elementBurst.name: Elemental Burst
elementBurst.desc: Strikes every enemy with the chosen element. A boss takes half.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.desc: Strikes every enemy for part of their health. A boss takes half.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Restores part of the health of everyone in the party still standing.

reviveMember.name: Revive Member
reviveMember.desc: Brings the chosen party member back on their feet.

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.desc: Brings every fallen ally back on their feet.

aura.name: Aura
aura.desc: The power comes off this character.

summon.name: Summon
summon.desc: The power manifests in battle as a summon modelled on the chosen pet.
